axes.concept: Open consultation sheets: press a plan to highlight it for comparison, without editing catalogue facts or assigning an account plan. All tool lists remain visible.
axes.layout: Full-width horizontal sheets with a 248px identity/price column and a two-column tool list at 1100px and above. At 640–1099px the comparison becomes a two-by-two sheet grid; below 640px it becomes a single stack. The extra selection view uses a two-by-two grid from 640px.
axes.navigation: Preserved Pictures/Sempertex masthead and account disclosure; neutral horizontal Compare plans / Select to compare links, four jump anchors in the full comparison, and return to the complete comparison. Existing login and account entries retain /planes destinations.
axes.typography: Existing locally embedded Geist Sans and Geist Mono: 24px task heading, 20px plan names, 22px tabular prices, 14px tool labels, 12–13px availability and context. No display typography or new family.
axes.density: Open, content-sized sheets; 28px desktop, 24px tablet and 20px phone horizontal insets. Existing 32px panels and pill controls. Tablet tools use one text column per sheet rather than squeezed desktop columns. Selection highlights retain the same sheet geometry.
axes.components: Installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input and Skeleton recomposed into plan selection and the existing entry surfaces; native view/state/theme/motion/language selectors, native account disclosure, semantic article/list/link elements and Lucide check/arrow icons.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures light/dark semantic tokens. Neutral sheet surfaces and navigation; existing acento marks only comparison selection and actions; aviso identifies unavailable tools. Same source palette and dark primary foreground as sibling contracts.
axes.motion: Expressive open-sheet settling uses 440ms unfold with 45ms offsets and the existing ease-out curve; selected-label stamp and interruptible Motion spring on selection press. Controls respond in 180ms. Natural/subtle reduce timing; reduced motion and still remove travel and preserve all feedback; hidden tabs pause CSS animation.
